tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt:
You recently joined a student organization at your university that focuses on environmental conservation. The group is planning an upcoming event to raise awareness about recycling and reducing waste. You have some ideas for activities and would like to share them with the group leader, Julia.
Write an email to Julia. In your email, do the following:
Write as much as you can and in complete sentences.
bullets: Describe your ideas for the awareness event.
Explain why you believe these activities will be effective.
Offer to help organize and implement the activities.
tasks.to: Julia Subject: Ideas for recycling awareness event
tasks.subject: Ideas for recycling awareness event
tasks.sample:
Dear Julia,



I hope this email finds you well. I know that our student organization is currently planning an event focused on recycling and reducing waste, and I am writing to share a few ideas for activities.



One idea is to organize a short workshop to teach students how to properly sort recyclable materials and reduce waste in daily life. We could set up interactive booths with simple games or quizzes to make the whole event more engaging. In addition, inviting a guest speaker to talk about the environmental benefits of recycling could help raise awareness.



I believe these activities will be effective because they encourage active participation and help students better understand the importance of recycling. I would be happy to help organize and implement these activities if needed. I look forward to hearing from you.



Best regards,

Kelly
tasks.title: Write an Email
